goal: Expose existing structured knowledge and evidence as a read-only, evidence-grounded Conversation product surface and validate it through the formal server and a fixed C1/C2 comparison.
acceptance_criteria: Conversation reuses the existing knowledge, retrieval, capability, guard, and model-routing authorities
grounded answers, provenance, fidelity drill-down, no-evidence refusal, and Provider fallback pass targeted tests
the complete formal server evaluation passes with a real Conversation route
a fixed ten-case flat-complete versus structured Conversation evaluation produces auditable evidence
full repository regression has zero failures and zero errors

quality_metrics.method: deterministic pytest suite with fake Provider and real MCP process

quality_metrics.measure: C2 accuracy and irrelevant-context efficiency relative to C1
quality_metrics.target: accuracy comparable or better and irrelevant context reduced at least 30 percent
quality_metrics.method: ten fixed questions over one frozen corpus, model, rubric, and answer budget
active-repository profile plus collection and application suite

improvement: harden staged pytest against unrelated workstation plugin autoload

interface_expectations: conversation.answer@1.0 remains a common Component/Block capability
cgkn_conversation returns answer, status, evidence, provenance, and retrieval audit metadata
summary nodes remain indexes and exact-detail queries can expand only their referenced raw evidence

feedback: Conversation is now a read-only evidence-grounded Component/Block surface over the existing knowledge authority.
Formal server, real E2E, fixed C1/C2 comparison, and full regression passed on one frozen source commit.
Multi-Agent remains not recommended because current evidence favors cheap execution and structured evidence over additional orchestration.

worked: reusing the existing cgnk_knowledge retrieval authority
strict grounded claim references and honest evidence-only fallback
did_not_work: an outdated local API Lab worktree produced fail-closed contract-version errors until the frozen dependency SHA was used
a lexical-only retry rubric treated two retries and twice as different until deterministic normalization
experiments: C1 flat-complete and C2 structured both reached 10/10 accuracy; C2 reduced input tokens by 74.71 percent and irrelevant-context ratio by 57.67 percent
